authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Ordered components one + like: CDIAL 2462 subsection 2 explicitly gives modern ek/āk one. Platts page 621 comparative sā like/resembling is explicitly derived through a Prakrit form from sadṛśa plus ka. It is distinct from the adjacent intensifying sā entry. CDIAL 13120 supplies the sadṛśa like family. These same responses are interpreted as comparative ek + sā/so/sī, preserving gender/vowel forms, spacing and regional pronunciation. The sadṛśa link records the base of the documented suffixed derivation, not an unsuffixed direct sound change. Local transmission is unresolved. Exact response: ek sā.
